limits: Municipal embedded tower coordinates are the position control, not an engineering survey. The exact-QID OSM node lies about18.3m south, and its identity alone does not validate its point position. North-up aerial and the inspected July2026 west-side photograph establish house/tower quadrant; photo metadata azimuth312 disagrees with the GPS-to-tower direction and is not used as a bearing. House centering follows the mapped rectangle; its scale, 8.5m square tower base, taper, windows, floor allocation, rail spacing and fittings remain photo proportions. Towerheight32m is distinct from focalheight36m; Y0 uses host terrain contact, not surveyed sea level. Detached station buildings, hedges, shore and interiors are not part of this asset. Paint age and individual masonry are generalized.
